verifications.note: Federal Register notice of November 16, 2000. It says Columbia Gulf filed on November 3, 2000, under docket CP01-28, to build the Vicksburg Lateral, about 37 miles of 20-inch pipe from its mainline in Richland Parish, Louisiana, to Warren County, Mississippi.

Oil & Gas Journal article of November 14, 2000. Columbia Gulf will build a 37-mile lateral from its mainline near Delhi, Louisiana, to two power plants south of Vicksburg, Mississippi, expected in service by May 2001.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Proposed November 2000. A Federal Register notice says Columbia Gulf filed on November 3, 2000, under docket CP01-28, and an Oil & Gas Journal article of November 14, 2000 reported the plan.

verifications.note: Natural Gas Intelligence article of February 12, 2001. FERC approved the Vicksburg lateral, docket CP01-28, the week before.

verifications.note: PHMSA special permit analysis for Columbia Gulf's Mainline 100, 200 and 300 in Tennessee. It gives the year each Mainline 100 segment was built as 1953, 1953/1954 or 1954.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Construction year 1953. A PHMSA special permit analysis gives 1953 and 1954 as the construction years of Mainline 100 segments in Tennessee. The line was built by Gulf Interstate Gas Co. No source on when it was proposed was found.

verifications.note: PHMSA special permit analysis for Columbia Gulf's Mainline 100, 200 and 300 in Tennessee. It gives the year each Mainline 100 segment was built as 1953, 1953/1954 or 1954.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Start year 1954. A PHMSA special permit analysis gives 1954 as the construction year of most Mainline 100 segments. No source gives the date of first gas, so this is inferred from the end of construction. Mainline 200 (1958 to 1963) and Mainline 300 (1968 to 1969) were added later.
